name: Video & Audio
description: Index video and audio files with transcription and frame analysis.
longDescription: Process long video and audio files for your knowledge base. Splits oversized Whisper uploads, captures scene-change-aware frames in a bounded pass, and supports local files, bounded direct URL downloads, and YouTube videos/playlists. Includes ffmpeg automatically and prepares the YouTube downloader on first use.
author: Larkup

configSchema.label: Frame extraction interval (seconds)
configSchema.help: Baseline cadence for duration-aware coverage frames; scene changes and a reserved ending pass are added separately.

configSchema.label: Audio Provider
configSchema.help: Choose the provider that should transcribe both audio files and video audio tracks.

configSchema.label: Transcription language
configSchema.help: Use auto for provider language detection, or enter a language code such as ar, ar-EG, en, or de to override it.

configSchema.label: Audio API Key
configSchema.help: Required for the selected provider. This key is used only by the Video & Audio tool.
